why:
The finding is real. The chapter is theories/becoming/chapters/CIVILIZATION-THOUGHT-AND-BECOMING.md, and the line is §八 item 6, line 319. Neither 「三人言而成虎」 nor 「成虎」 occurs in zhonghua/passages.json, which has 1,300 entries and 76 with a non-empty gap. The story is in the source corpus, in 内储说上 (FA1-S-H30.txt), but no entry maps it. Every other quotation in §八 does occur in passages.json, counting the traditional forms 謂其存者損, 一人學戰 and 其勢險. So item 6 is the only one that names a passage outside the map, even though §八 says its statements live in the gap field.

Two entries state the correlated-witness gap G1:
- hanfei-shi-ren-yun-yi, FA1-S-H48 (八經), with the fragment 「…十人云疑，百人然乎，千人不可解也」
- hanfei-bu-shi-xiang-yu, FA1-S-H09 (八姦), with the fragment 「必實其能，察其過，不使羣臣相爲語」

I checked the chapter names against the source texts: H48 is 八經 and H09 is 八姦. hanfei-yi-duo-xin quotes the same 八經 line, but its gap is about majority rule, not G1.

The Lean shows the gap is still open. WitnessRefinementRuns has only doubled_roster_same, an exact duplicate roster. WitnessRefinement has only the constructed examples duplicated_fifth_no_repair and uncovered_correlation_deletes_actual. No general law is proved.

I changed the reviewer's replacement in one way. Both G1 gap statements require the dependent witness's fault set to coincide with the other's. They say 「其故障集合与之重合」, not only that its report is a function of the other's. Without that condition, item 6 states a stronger conjecture than the gap does. So the replacement keeps the condition, in plain words, since the chapter has no fault vocabulary. The citation form, 「traditional quote」〔ID〕, follows the chapter's own convention at lines 151–166. The find occurs exactly once in the chapter.
find: 韩非“三人言而成虎”：一个见证者的报告若是另一个的函数，加入它不改变任何检查。
replace: 韩非八经「十人云疑，百人然乎，千人不可解也」〔FA1-S-H48〕、八奸「不使羣臣相爲語」〔FA1-S-H09〕：一个见证者的报告若是另一个的函数，且与之在同样的情形下出错，加入它不改变任何检查。
